claim_boundary: The D-prime failure is source-bound to the nu=1/3 point-contact conductance and t=log(T/T_B).
The exact boundary S matrix is not silently identified with the integrated scalar conductance.
The O(N) and graph results are composition controls, not four-dimensional quantum-gravity candidates.
No physical D-prime derivation, cosmology, UV completion, RH result, or abc result is claimed.

external_composition_controls.kill_gate: multiparticle operator factorization is not a closed real scalar response law with marked absorbing boundaries
external_composition_controls.positive: massive asymptotically-free 1+1D theory with an exact factorized S matrix

external_composition_controls.kill_gate: scalar transmission loses phase/channel data and the source supplies no coupling running or RG response path
external_composition_controls.positive: exact composition rule for full unitary on-shell scattering matrices

composition_boundary.forbidden_substitution: one-by-one quasiparticle scattering or S-matrix unitarity is not a binary conductance law
composition_boundary.missing_object: a closed binary law C(G1,G2) for the conductance itself
composition_boundary.physical_observable_construction: G is a TBA-weighted momentum integral of |S_++|^2 and occupation factors

primary_near_candidate.observable: linear point-contact conductance G(T/T_B) at filling fraction nu=1/3
primary_near_candidate.physical_scope: integrable boundary sine-Gordon description of fractional-quantum-Hall edge transport

source_asymptotics.coefficient_independence: A and B cancel from the endpoint generator limits

scalar_composition_counterexample.conclusion: no phase-blind binary law C(T1,T2) can reproduce exact S-matrix composition
scalar_composition_counterexample.source_class: exact serial composition of full unitary scattering matrices

excluded_reuse: Bjorken effective-charge CSR transitivity as a physical response law
2D Yang-Mills area composition as 4D scattering or RG time
required: physical gauge-independent or gauge-invariant scattering/transport observable
two finite distinguishable source-predeclared boundary responses
independently source-defined exact nonperturbative binary response composition
coupling running or source-defined RG crossover on a declared additive scale
